name: @tavli/server
description: Authoritative online game server: matchmaking, private rooms, ratings

scripts.build: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:worker
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --packages=bundle --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/server.js
scripts.build:worker: esbuild src/analysis-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --packages=bundle --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/analysis-worker.js
